description: Human-in-the-loop policy: which actions need a recorded human approval, how it is bound and who may decide. Consumers: human-approval-agent, approval-router, the evaluate-human-approval, request-human-approval, resume-after-approval and reject-unsafe-automation skills, and the human-approval gate (automation-runs-gated).

binding.payloadHash: an approval is valid only for the exact payload hash it was requested for
binding.expiry: an approval expires; an expired approval is treated as denied

onMissing: stop the automation at its checkpoint, record the stop and route the case to the exception owner
onDenied: stop, record the decision and do not retry the same payload
